title: A normalized Gaussian density identity
statement: For every $\rho\in(0,1)$ and every real $t>0$, the following identity holds, where $\varphi(t)$ is the density of the standard normal distribution: $\displaystyle \frac{(\sqrt{2\pi})^{2/(1+\rho)}\bigl(\varphi(t)/t\bigr)^{2/(1+\rho)}}{t^{2-2/(1+\rho)}}=\frac{\exp\bigl(-t^2/(1+\rho)\bigr)}{t^2}$.
